author: Mark Atwood
text: Maintainer risk: MEDIUM — two P0 correctness bugs (id recycling, per-user-routing path-key misclassification) and four P1 issues (canonical-template divergences, README staleness, getAvailability ordering, change_log dedup masking) ship together with a fresh MemoryBackend that consumers will study. The cookie-cutter divergences from jmap-mail-server (MemoryError shape, calendar_has_events bool-vs-Result) are the highest maintenance-burden items because they'll get copied by third parties studying the reference impl.
